facts.claim: PGwire uses local BicDb/SqlSession and local statement/transaction snapshots. Cluster planning methods are explicit helpers; source inspection does not establish transparent SQL forwarding.

Only the cfg(test) RecordingCommitProtocol implementation was found. Generic execute_distributed_transaction has no production decision registry, participant-intent recovery/enumeration or ordinary SQL integration.

Final-row admission remains range-local. The generic distributed transaction helper aborts only acknowledged prepared prefix after failed Prepare; an uncertain failed recipient requires the separately designed all-enlisted recovery contract.
A per-range native Strong read and one-range fifth-member handoff do not supply one common SQL snapshot, general distributed joins or atomic multi-range business writes.
